messages:
Asha (CS): Quick heads-up — onboarding embedding indexing is failing for a subset of VPC/private tenants after last night's DB migration. Some indexing jobs are stuck in retry and not completing. Need an embargoed customer status blurb + per-tenant ETA.

IncidentBot: New incident logged INC-2026-457 — embedding index jobs failing post-migration. Bridge: https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-457. Severity: high.

Marcus (SRE): Root cause: the migration inadvertently lowered the internal indexer write timeout causing batch aborts and a retry-state loop. Action taken: reverted the timeout change and paused new indexing starts. Requeue of pending jobs started at 03:12 UTC.

Liam (Eng): Rollback confirmed at 03:12 UTC. Requeue kicking off; ~80% of jobs will auto-complete. ~20% of jobs ended up in a terminal retry state and need manual resume. Building a bulk-resume script now, ETA ~2.5 hours to process manual cases. I'll drop the script + runbook in /shared/cs after smoke tests.

Marcus (SRE): Current per-tenant snapshot (also uploaded to /shared/cs/emb-index-affected.csv): tenant-tango ~20m, tenant-unicorn manual resume queued ~40m, tenant-halo reprocessing ~75m, tenant-sierra needs data scrub and manual retry ~3-4h. I'll update the CSV every 30m.

Asha (CS): Draft customer-facing short status for high-touch outreach: 'We're investigating an issue affecting embedding index processing for some private/VPC customers after a database migration. Our engineering team has reverted the change and is reprocessing indexing jobs. Most tenants should be recovered within 3 hours; your CS rep will follow up with a tenant-specific ETA and remediation options.' Thoughts?

Priya (SE): Add: 'No model weights or raw customer files were deleted or exposed — this is an indexing state/regeneration problem.' Also I can translate FR/DE and add to shared folder.

Jorge (CS Manager): Approve the message. Recommend credit options: a one-week dedicated-capacity credit OR a one-time $500 onboarding credit for heavily impacted customers. Also schedule office hours tomorrow 9-11am PT for affected accounts. Add explicit renewals-escalation path for any account flagged at risk.

Asha (CS): Good. I'll attach the CSV + per-tenant ETA column and send this to priority customers in ~15m. Need a Zendesk canned reply we can paste.

Marcus (SRE): Support template uploaded: /shared/cs/templates/emb-index-incident.txt. Suggested snippet: 'We are aware of an indexing issue following a DB migration. Our team has reverted the change and is reprocessing your indexing jobs. Expected recovery: <ETA>. If indexing does not recover after <threshold>, please run the diagnostic below and include the job id when opening a ticket.'

Priya (SE): Diagnostic curl check (paste-able): ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/indexing/status
# returns: {"state":"processing|queued|failed","last_error":"...","job_id":"..."}```

Liam (Eng): Confirmed no model artifacts were affected. We'll publish a full RCA and timeline once the reprocessing completes.

Asha (CS): After I send the emails I'll publish a list of accounts reached + responses here. Also we should capture feedback during office hours and add it to the affected-tenants spreadsheet. Priya — please drop translations and short copy variants (email + slack DM) in /shared/cs/i18n.

Jorge (CS Manager): Approved credit wording: 'You may opt-in to either a 1-week dedicated-capacity credit OR a one-time $500 onboarding credit. To opt-in, reply to this message or open a ticket titled "Indexing Credit - <tenant>".' Also let's surface any renewal flags to GTM.

Asha (CS): Sending priority outreach now. Will post final sent copy + list of tenants reached in 30m. Thanks all. :heart:
